header.running_head: Enduring Hunger when Inviting People Towards Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ

blocks.text: The Hunger Suffered by Rasulullaah ﷺ, His Family, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and Hadhrat Umar (RA)
Rasulullaah ﷺ, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and Hadhra Umar (RA) Suffer Extreme Hunger and Meet up with Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA)

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) narrates that when the afternoon heat was at its peak, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) left for the Masjid. Hearing him, leave Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked, "O Abu Bakr! What has made you leave your house at this hour?" Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied, "It is the extreme pangs of hunger that as made me leave home." Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "By Allaah! It is nothing else that has made me leave my home." As they spoke, Rasulullaah ﷺ arrived there and asked, "What has made you two leave your homes at this hour?" "It is the extreme pangs of hunger that has made us leave home." Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "I swear by the Being Who controls my life! It is nothing else that has made me leave my home. Stand up."

The three then went to the door of Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) who always used to keep some food or milk aside for Rasulullaah ﷺ. However, Rasulullaah ﷺ had been late that day and did not arrive at the usual time (to receive the food). Subsequently, Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) fed the food to his family and had left to work in his orchard. When they arrived at the door, the wife of Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) came and said, "Welcome to the Nabi of Allaah ﷺ and to those with him." When Rasulullaah ﷺ asked her where Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) was, Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) happened to overhear this as he was working in his orchard and came running.

Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) said, "Welcome to the Nabi of Allaah ﷺ and to those with him. O Nabi of Allaah ﷺ! This is not the time you usually come." "That is true," replied Rasulullaah ﷺ. Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) then left to cut off a branch of a date palm which contained a variety of ripe dates, juicy dates and dry dates. Rasulullaah ﷺ asked him, "Why have you done this? Why did you not rather select a few ripe dates from the branch?" Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) replied, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! I wanted to you to eat from the variety of ripe, juicy and dry dates. Say what you may, I am now going to slaughter an animal to eat with this." Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "If you are slaughtering something, do not slaughter a milk-giving animal."

Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) then slaughtered a kid and said to his wife, "Make some dough for us and bake some bread because you know better how to bake." Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) then cooked half of the kid and roasted the other half.
